headline: California Proposition 40 Is Projected to Fail
deck: California voters rejected the proposed one-time 5% tax on billionaire assets, leaving the measure without the approval needed to take effect.
body: California voters rejected Proposition 40, a ballot measure that The Associated Press declared had failed, according to the Los Angeles Times. The outlet put the result at roughly 53% against and 47% in favor. [E1] [E2] The Guardian also reported that the proposed one-time wealth tax was defeated. [E4]

Proposition 40 sought a one-time 5% tax on California billionaires’ assets to help offset federal healthcare funding cuts. [E3] With voters rejecting the proposal, the tax was not approved to take effect.
